entities.name: Miguel Cortijo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel Alberto Cortijo is a retired Argentine basketball player. He spent his mostly career at Ferro Carril Oeste, the club where he won 4 local titles. Cortijo is considered one of the best point guards in Argentine basketball history.
